plugins.name: aikido
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for Aikido Security — scan code for vulnerabilities and secrets, triage findings, fix security issues, and sync to GitHub Issues using the Aikido MCP server.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture documentation through the `architect` agent: arc42 sections, architectural decision records, technical debt records, and C4, sequence, state-machine, and deployment diagrams. Fills the `architecture` role a flow consults, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: claude-desktop
plugins.description: Claude Code host plugin: the start, session-handoff, and create-pull-request skills plus the orch-dashboard MCP server that renders a run dashboard, Mermaid diagrams, and Markdown documents inline. The orchestration lane it used to ship continues as delivery@jsdotnet.

plugins.name: csharp-coding
plugins.description: C# .NET implementation through the `coding` agent: test-driven development, refactoring, code review and optimization, NuGet management, Aspire wiring, OpenTelemetry, and Azure SDK patterns. Fills the `implement` and `verify` services a flow runs its code stages through, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: documentation
plugins.description: Documentation and profile artifacts through the `documentation` and `profile` agents: how-to guides, explanations, articles, proposals, ideas, and SVG infographics, plus GitHub, LinkedIn, and project profiles. Fills the `docs` role a flow consults, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: domain-design
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design through the `domain-architect` agent: bounded context discovery, ubiquitous language, domain model and interaction design, context mapping, and aggregate, domain-event-flow, and subdomain diagrams. Fills the `domain` role a flow consults, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: fincent
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for Fincent project story review, dev, domain alignment, story point estimation, PR review, PR remark resolution, sprint reporting, and demo presentation workflows.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for GitHub platform workflows — issue sync, pull requests, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and Dependabot configuration.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for Jira issue synchronization workflows. Creates and updates Jira issues from approved Markdown backlog artifacts.

plugins.name: product-owner
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for product backlog authoring — epics, stories, and bugs as Markdown artifacts.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Copilot plugin for runtime QA validation — run Aspire-orchestrated apps, drive Playwright browser scenarios with evidence for each, and monitor Aspire logs/traces during the test session.

plugins.name: react-coding
plugins.description: React and TypeScript implementation through the `frontend` agent: components, hooks, routes, typed API clients bound to a .NET API contract, and component tests, with the build, typecheck, lint, and test commands detected from the repository rather than assumed. Fills the `implement` and `verify` services a flow runs its frontend stages through, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Copilot plugin providing reusable review skills for any agent — supports TODO-driven, question-driven, and improvement-driven reviews of code, stories, documentation, architecture, and more.

plugins.name: spec-builder
plugins.description: Copilot plugin focused on GitHub customization asset authoring workflows.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: UX design through the `ux-designer` agent: wireframes, user flows, design guidelines, and UI reviews, as SVG or Mermaid artifacts and structured Markdown. Fills the `ux` role a flow consults, and is usable on its own. Holds no flow control: sequencing, approval, and delegation belong to whatever consults it.

plugins.name: wip-convention
plugins.description: Encapsulates the .wip folder convention for storing work-in-progress artifacts. Provides skills and instructions to align agents with the .wip workflow.
